items.title: Rescuers search for survivors of powerful Indonesia earthquake
items.description: Officials say a rapid assessment into the impact of the earthquake that destroyed hundreds of buildings and killed 47 is under way.

items.title: Hawaii battles strong winds and rain as Hurricane Lala threat looms
items.description: If the storm makes landfall, it will be Hawaii's first direct hit by a hurricane in 34 years.

items.title: Twelve killed as Polish bus veers off Hungarian motorway
items.description: Dozens more are seriously injured after the tourist bus overturned in the early hours of Sunday morning.

items.title: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to cross into Ceuta, reports say
items.description: Security had been stepped up amid suggestions on social media of a second mass crossing on Saturday.

items.title: Liechtenstein changes succession rule to allow women to ascend the throne
items.description: The declaration was made on the national day of the central European country, which has a population of just 44,000.

items.title: Qatar denies capturing three Iranian pilots after downing fighter jets
items.description: Iran claims they have been held since Qatar downed two fighter jets at the start of the US-Iran war.

items.title: Multiple suspects at large after five shot at Virginia State University, police say
items.description: Police responded to reports of a shooting outside a residence halls at about 01:28 local time (05:28 GMT) on Saturday.

items.title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
items.description: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as earlier action against its soldiers.

items.title: Australian state to launch gun buyback after Bondi Beach attack
items.description: New South Wales, where the attack took place, will offer gun owners cash to give up their firearms.

items.title: Family stranded at sea for 16 hours after jet ski capsized in Thailand
items.description: A father and his two young sons spent a night adrift before being rescued off the coast of the island of Koh Samui.

items.title: BBC seeks to subpoena family members in Panorama lawsuit
items.description: A spokesperson for Trump's legal team responded to the request accusing the broadcaster of "seeking to harass" the president's family.

items.title: Firefighters battle wildfire tearing through Belgian nature reserve
items.description: The fire burning through the major park was described as the country's worst in recent years.
